lede: Town Council meets Tuesday, October 27 with a full plate: the Fourth Supplement to the Gondola IGA — extending cost-sharing for the 2027 planning budget tied to the SMART 3A funding voters approved — gets a decision, and two ordinances, including one amending the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program, get their first readings. Ouray County commissioners are also busy, with a work session on a proposed EMS and Ridgway Fire merger and a regular meeting to consider extending the Emergency Disaster Declaration. Amid all that, the valley wraps up its Halloween stretch with the Witches Ride, Young Frankenstein at the Sheridan, and a Remembrance Garden dedication ceremony on Tuesday.
